free_parameters.name: kernel_h_size
free_parameters.why: Concrete Pool2d kernel height; any positive integer satisfies the guard and the target decision depends only on the flag.

free_parameters.name: kernel_w_size
free_parameters.why: Concrete Pool2d kernel width; any positive integer satisfies the guard and the target decision depends only on the flag.

free_parameters.name: stride
free_parameters.why: Concrete Pool2d stride; a valid positive stride needed only to build the operator before the target line.

free_parameters.name: padding
free_parameters.why: Concrete Pool2d padding; a valid non-negative padding needed only to build the operator before the target line.

free_parameters.name: input_shape
free_parameters.why: Concrete NCHW input shape; the branch reads only the module flag, not the shape, so the concrete size is immaterial.

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: Pool2d only accepts floating dtypes; float32 is a valid member and dtype cannot affect the flag branch.

execution.entry_reason: The official call_chain[0] PracticalHybridSearch.search_one is the torch input-search routine and never constructs operator constraints, so it cannot reach Pool2d.requires; the target is the module-flag branch inside requires, which the driver calls directly with a real Pool2d and a real AbsTensor.
